summary_en: Tender period extended from 2026-06-26 to 2026-07-14 (42 business days from 2026-05-18). Price ¥1,580/share unchanged. Minimum acceptance 19,226,700 shares (size not disclosed as %). Target: complete subsidiary. Financing via Mitsubishi UFJ Bank loan. Board recommendation unchanged.
title_en: Notice of Amendment to Opinion on Tender Offer for Shinko Shoji Shares by Kaga Electronics Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief: On 26 June 2026, Shinko Shoji announced an amendment to its 15 May 2026 opinion statement regarding Kaga Electronics' tender offer for Shinko shares. The key change: Kaga Electronics has extended the tender period from 30 business days (ending 26 June 2026) to 42 business days (now ending 14 July 2026), starting from 18 May 2026. The tender price remains ¥1,580 per ordinary share, with a minimum acceptance threshold of 19,226,700 shares required to complete the transaction. The stated purpose is to make Shinko a wholly-owned subsidiary. Kaga Electronics stated the extension was decided to provide Shinko shareholders additional opportunity to assess the offer based on subscription trends and outlook, while maintaining that the ¥1,580 price adequately reflects the company's value and is in shareholders' best interest. Financing is to be arranged via a Mitsubishi UFJ Bank loan, conditional on successful completion of the tender, with funds to be drawn by the business day before settlement. The offer document does not disclose an upper limit on shares to be acquired or the percentage of outstanding shares represented by the 19.2M minimum threshold.
